query:
SELECT 
  s.id as searchId,
  s.searchName,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.productImages IS NOT NULL AND c.productImages != '[]' AND c.productImages != 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hasProductImages,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.urgencyImages IS NOT NULL AND c.urgencyImages != '[]' AND c.urgencyImages != 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hasUrgencyImages,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.callReadinessSummary IS NOT NULL AND c.callReadinessSummary != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hasWhyCallToday
FROM companies c
JOIN searches s ON c.searchId = s.id
WHERE s.id IN (1500003, 1350004)
GROUP BY s.id, s.searchName;
